title: Language Has Two Parameters: Narrative-Induced Semantic Plasticity and Phase-Sensitive Interpretation
abstract: arXiv:2608.18041v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language has two parameters. Count how often words occur together and you estimate amplitude, the strength of association. Word embeddings and attention weights refine that count, which sums every writer in the corpus together. This paper claims a second parameter, phase, which signed weights learned from a corpus do not supply. Phase exists only between meanings: it determines how coactivated meanings combine, and it can reverse what a meaning contributes while that meaning stays fully present. A speaker can set phase in the signal through linguistic form; encounters install phase relations and history distributes them. Population averaging deletes history-indexed phase: agent-deindexed corpora identify the population marginal state and determine no individual or dyadic state, at any scale. translated_title: 语言有两个参数：叙事引发的语义可塑性与相位敏感解读
translated_abstract: 语言具有两个参数。统计词语共同出现的频率，可估算出关联强度，即幅度。词嵌入和注意力权重优化了这一统计，它汇总了语料库中所有作者的信息。本文提出第二个参数——相位，这是从语料库中学到的带符号权重无法提供的。相位仅存在于意义之间：它决定共激活的意义如何组合，并能在意义保持完全在场时逆转其贡献。说话者可通过语言形式在信号中设置相位；遭遇会建立相位关系，历史则分布这些关系。总体平均会删除历史索引的相位：去代理索引的语料库识别总体边际状态，但无法确定任何个体或二元状态，无论尺度如何。标准Transformer在冻结推理中缺乏对相位的显式表示，而以单一指标衡量进展的可解释性程序也未能捕捉这一维度。
tldr: 本文提出语言存在第二个参数“相位”，它决定共激活意义的组合方式并可能逆转其贡献，而标准Transformer和现有可解释性方法均未能显式表示这一参数。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes that language has a second parameter, "phase," which determines how coactivated meanings combine and can reverse their contributions, yet standard transformers and current interpretability methods fail to explicitly represent it.
